headline: Keep illustrated boosters consistent between the game and Nut Emporium

changes.title: Use the same approved booster art in gameplay and the shop
changes.detail: The Nut Emporium now uses the existing in-game PNG picture renderer for all 16 boosters, including the advanced variants' visible badges. The compact tactical controls, stock counts, purchase rules and saved inventory are unchanged.

changes.title: Guard booster artwork against missing images and UI drift
changes.detail: A report-only regression checks all 16 committed PNGs, the ten compact booster controls, two hold tools, six advanced tools, matching shop artwork and Android/Fire OS asset packaging. Native desktop parity is still unfinished.
